heroHeadline: Zelensky Calls for Lasting Peace After Trump Call; WFP Warehouse Destroyed; Ukraine Strikes Bryansk Fuel Depot — Day 1,553
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,553 of Russia's full-scale invasion, President Zelensky spoke with Trump and declared Ukraine seeks 'a real peace — not just another pause between Russian invasions,' signaling readiness for talks but rejecting any outcome short of binding security guarantees. Russia struck Mykolaiv overnight (122 Shahed drones + 2 Iskander-M missiles), damaging residential and administrative buildings. The UN World Food Programme confirmed a Russian Iskander missile destroyed its Dnipro warehouse on May 25-26, eliminating $1.4M of food aid for 130,000 people — the second strike on the same facility. Ukraine struck the Belets oil depot in Bryansk Oblast, disrupting fuel supply to Russian front-line forces. Zelensky also warned Belarus of 'consequences' if it deepens its military role. Cumulative Russian losses reached ~1,357,950 (+1,010 on May 26). Ukraine has been invited to the upcoming NATO summit in Ankara.
